description: Simulates the attacking unit once with each enhancement its characters, including attached leaders, can take in the attacker's detachment, and once with none, against the defender, as simulate_combat does. Takes the same sides as simulate_combat; name the attacker's detachment, since enhancements come from it. Any enhancement the sides name is replaced by the one being compared. points keeps only enhancements costing that much or less, such as the points a list has spare. mode ranks shooting followed by melee (combined), or one phase. Returns without, the result with no enhancement, and enhancements, best first, each with its bearer, points and outcome. An enhancement with notCalculated has rules the simulator cannot estimate, so its outcome leaves them out; say so rather than ranking it. It compares damage against this one defender only, never what an enhancement does for movement, durability elsewhere or scoring.

modifiers.description: Situational modifiers the simulator page offers, such as { "all": { "cover": true, "hitModifier": -1 } }, { "melee": { "charged": true } }, { "ranged": { "distance": 18 } }, or { "target": { "invulnerable": 4 } }. distance is the inches to the target: weapons that cannot reach it make no attacks and are marked outOfRange, and each weapon is within half range by its own Range. commandReroll spends one Command Re-roll per phase on the first failed hit, wound, or save roll, or the first single-die Attacks roll below its average; compare with a run without it to judge the CP.

points.description: Only enhancements costing at most this many points, such as the points the list has left.
